name: Rowan
source:
A charismatic young man who is practicing to take over his father's jewelry business. Despite his abundant confidence, he's seemingly a well-rounded and kind person. He's Elm's older twin brother.

"I'm sure you've got some reservations about partnering with a man you've only met two days ago, no matter how charming the meeting might have been."

Dislikes: the forest, isolation, contract negotiation
Likes: reading novels on the fireplace, brunch on the veranda, practicing his negotiating skills

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072470/Crimson_Waves_on_the_Emerald_Sea_Amaranthine_Moon/]Steam[/url]]
